summary: Frontend-only testing of the rebuilt Underwater Campus (v4 layered art). Verified all data-testids, 6+ unlockable buildings per zone, UW asset HTTP 200s + naturalWidth>0, fish directions (scaleX sign matches dx), strollers (charlie-surf not flipped, sharky-snorkel flipped) present on all 3 zones, swim-to-door swims then navigates (play->/#/simon-says, learn->/#/lessons, create->/#/free-play), locked buildings show lock chip, shake and don't swim/navigate, parallax (back ~0.3*scrollLeft, front ~-0.2*scrollLeft), swipe hint hides on scroll, HomePage layered backdrop images load, /#/free-play (deep variant) has NO sand strips, /#/play & /#/dressing-room load, mobile 390x844 campus renders YOU avatar + buildings and swim-to-door navigates. All v4 acceptance criteria pass.
action_items: Non-blocking: React warning 'Encountered two children with the same key' observed on campus pages. Likely from mapping backAccents/frontAccents with key={i} on nested divs that remount, or Swimmer strollers using key={src} when the same src appears twice. Consider stable composite keys (e.g., `${a.kind}-${i}` and `${src}-${i}`) in CampusMapPage.js backAccents/frontAccents/strollers maps.

Non-blocking: Console warning 'An empty string ("") was passed to the src attribute' appears on /#/campus?zone=create — a Building (likely jam-session Host) or Swimmer may receive an empty src for one frame. Guard / rendering when src is falsy.
critical_code_review_comments: CampusMapPage.js backAccents/frontAccents use key={i} inside .map which is OK for static arrays but duplicated keys may arise if arrays share the same wrapper — switch to kind+index composite keys.
Swimmer stroller map uses key={src}; sharky/charlie appear once per zone so OK on campus but if ever doubled would collide.
Minor: Host img has src from b.host which should always exist for defined buildings; still worth guarding to silence empty-src warning on /#/campus?zone=create.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Campus v4 fully validated: 7 PLAY buildings, 5 LEARN, 3 CREATE (all data-testid campus-building-<id>). Lock selector is campus-building-<id>-lock; be careful counting buildings — filter out testids ending in -lock. On mobile the audio-overlay dismissal click uses coords (195,400). The name prompt only reappears after localStorage.clear(). free-play uses UnderwaterBackdrop deep=true (no sand). Vimeo 401s and WebGL stall warnings are environmental noise.
